label: Narrative rhythm
description: One clear dramatic idea; readable action and continuity across authored beats.
principles: Keep the main subject readable before secondary spectacle.
Let each authored action reach a visually understandable state before the next beat.
Maintain spatial continuity, screen direction and subject scale across cuts unless the direction explicitly changes them.
Preserve the specified ending; do not add a coda, title card, dialogue or new character.
evidence_status: Original direction heuristics; visual effectiveness requires provider renders and human evaluation, not guaranteed by unit tests.
priority: approved shot timing and reference roles
